K1: The shepherd tells Odysseus he is in Ithaca and the hero suppresses his joy.
K2: Athena drops her disguise and names herself, laughing at his lie.
K3: Odysseus reproaches the goddess for her absence since Troy.
K4: Odysseus understands why she kept apart and that she kept him alive.
